# Jersey Data Protection — Official Sources & Key References

## Primary Legislation
- Data Protection (Jersey) Law 2018 (current consolidated): https://www.jerseylaw.je/laws/current/l_3_2018
- Data Protection Authority (Jersey) Law 2018: https://www.jerseylaw.je/laws/current/l_4_2018
- Full PDF versions available from jerseylaw.je

## Regulator
- Jersey Office of the Information Commissioner (JOIC) / Jersey Data Protection Authority
  - Website: https://jerseyoic.org/
  - Report a breach: https://portal.jerseyoic.org/report-a-breach
  - Raise a concern: https://jerseyoic.org/raise-a-concern
  - Guidance for organisations: https://jerseyoic.org/organisations
  - Guidance for individuals: https://jerseyoic.org/individuals

## Important Guidance Areas (from JOIC)
- Data subject rights (access, erasure, rectification, etc.)
- Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)
- Data Protection by Design and by Default
- Breach notification
- Consent
- International transfers
- Exemptions (Part 7 of the Law)

## Related
- Freedom of Information (Jersey) Law 2011 (also overseen by JOIC)
- UK adequacy recognition for Jersey (relevant for transfers)

## Best Practice
Always consult the latest official consolidated version on jerseylaw.je and current guidance on jerseyoic.org before implementation. This skill provides structured assistance but is not a substitute for legal advice.
